Miami plastic surgery

Plastic Surgery Marketing in Miami: Website & Visibility Audits

Miami is one of the most competitive plastic surgery markets in the country, and we already represent a Miami plastic surgery practice. To protect that commitment, we do not take on a competing Miami practice for ongoing SEO, ads or content. What we offer Miami surgeons and practice managers is a complimentary website and visibility audit: a clear, written review of your procedure pages, surgeon profiles, local presence, ads and consultation path, walked through on a video call.

Ongoing plastic surgery marketing is not available in Miami. This page offers a complimentary audit and consultation only. It is not a waiting list, a paid exception or a free trial of ongoing service.
Request a complimentary Miami audit
See what the audit covers
  • Houston-based since 2013
  • Serving Miami practices remotely
  • No obligation
  • Findings are yours to keep
  • Miami issues
  • Audit scope
  • Process
  • Availability
  • Questions
  • Request audit

What we see in Miami

Why Miami practices benefit from an outside review

Miami plastic surgery competition runs across organic search, Maps, paid ads, social platforms and reviews, and it reaches beyond Miami-Dade: destination patients from other states and countries research for weeks before booking. Practices often have strong surgeons and weak online explanations of what those surgeons do. An independent audit shows where.

One page for many procedures

Body, breast and facial procedures share pages, so serious candidates cannot find specific candidacy and recovery information.

Credentials far from procedures

Board certification and training sit on an About page instead of beside the procedures each surgeon performs.

Destination patients underserved

Out-of-area patients need travel, recovery-stay and follow-up information that most sites leave to a phone call.

Language support unclear

Spanish pages exist, but forms or phone lines do not support Spanish replies, or the reverse.

How Miami cosmetic patients typically research (example of your audience)

  1. IdeaSocial media, a friend, or a search like 'BBL recovery time'
  2. CompareSurgeons, reviews, galleries, location
  3. ReadProcedure and surgeon pages
  4. InquireForm, call, chat or DM
  5. CoordinatorYour team qualifies and books

Search phrases are illustrative examples, not volume data.

Audit scope

What the complimentary Miami plastic surgery audit includes

This is the service currently available to Miami plastic surgery practices. It is a diagnostic with a written priority list. Ongoing SEO, Google Ads management or content production are not offered in Miami at this time.

Procedure-level visibility

Which priority procedures have their own page, how complete each is, and where pages overlap or compete.

Surgeon profiles and trust

Credentials, training, memberships and how clearly they connect to procedure pages.

Google Maps and local discovery

Profile categories, services, photos, review patterns and consistency across Miami-Dade directories.

Google Ads review

If you run ads and grant read access: targeting, negative keywords and where each procedure's clicks land.

Consultation conversion

Forms, calls and chat on mobile, tracking by procedure and source, and the path to your coordinator.

AI search readiness

How clearly surgeon, procedure and location facts are stated for AI search tools. No promised mentions.

What you receive: a written report ranked by impact and effort, and a video walk-through with your surgeon or practice manager. Your in-house team or current agency can implement it. For the broader approach we take in open markets, see our plastic surgery marketing overview.

Process

How the Miami audit works

The audit uses the first two stages of our process, assess and prioritize, and stops there.

  1. Request

    Send practice name, website, priority procedures and ZIP code.

  2. Assess

    We review public pages and listings; read-only analytics or ads access is optional and noted in the report.

  3. Prioritize

    Findings ranked by likely effect on qualified consultation requests, and by effort.

  4. Walk-through

    A video call to explain the findings and answer questions.

  5. Hand-off

    You keep the report. We do not follow up with ongoing-service offers in a reserved market.

Illustrative example

How we would approach a two-surgeon practice in Coral Gables

A hypothetical scenario, not a client.

  • Check that each surgeon’s focus procedures each have a dedicated page.
  • Confirm the Coral Gables office listing matches the website and directories.
  • Review whether ads for body procedures land on body-procedure pages.
  • Test the consultation form on a phone, in English and Spanish if offered.

What marketing cannot guarantee: rankings, Maps position, AI recommendations or surgical bookings. Clinical claims and results are the practice’s responsibility.

Availability and Miami-Dade notes

Miami availability, coverage and local observations

We are based in Houston and serve Miami practices remotely. We have no Miami office. Plastic surgery is reserved in Miami for an existing client, so only the audit and consultation are available here.

Reserved

Ongoing marketing

Not available to Miami plastic surgery practices. We will not represent a competing practice in protected ZIP codes.

Available

Complimentary audit

One audit and consultation per practice, without obligation, across Miami-Dade.

Outside Miami

Other Florida markets

Ask about other cities; each request is checked individually.

Florida healthcare marketing hub

Miami-Dade context the audit considers

Practices are spread across separate cities such as Coral Gables, Miami Beach, Aventura and Doral, and across City of Miami neighborhoods such as Brickell and Downtown, plus unincorporated areas like Kendall. Each office needs its own accurate listing, and destination patients need travel and recovery information regardless of where they start.

Local search notes (reviewed 6 November 2026)

Searches such as ‘plastic surgery marketing agency Miami’ returned national aesthetic-marketing specialists (at least one advertising its own Miami exclusivity model), Miami Beach and Miami aesthetics agencies, and bilingual Miami marketing firms. The market is crowded with offers, which is another reason we keep ours narrow and honest. Qualitative observations only.

Related: healthcare marketing in Miami and med spa SEO.

Questions and audit request

Miami plastic surgery audit questions

Clear answers about availability and the audit.

Is ongoing plastic surgery marketing currently available in Miami?

No. We represent a Miami plastic surgery practice and do not take on competing practices there for ongoing SEO, ads or content. We are telling you this up front so you can plan with your current team or another agency.

What does the complimentary audit include, and how is territory eligibility checked?

It covers procedure pages, surgeon profiles, Google Maps and reviews, ads and landing pages if you share read access, consultation forms and tracking, and AI-search readiness, delivered as a written priority list with a video walk-through. Eligibility for anything beyond the audit is checked by ZIP code; Miami is currently reserved for plastic surgery.

Should every procedure have its own page?

Priority procedures, yes: each needs candidacy, recovery, cost-factor and surgeon information. Related minor procedures can share a page. The audit identifies which ones matter for your practice.

How should we handle out-of-state and international patients?

Give them a page that explains travel planning, recovery stays, follow-up arrangements and how virtual consultations work, as your practice defines them. The audit checks whether that information exists and is easy to find.

Do Spanish pages help a Miami plastic surgery practice?

Often, if your coordinators can respond in Spanish. The audit checks whether translated pages, forms and phone handling actually match.

Do you make claims about surgical results or promise rankings?

No. Clinical claims belong to your surgeons, and no one can promise Maps positions, AI mentions or bookings.

Do you have an office in Miami?

No. We are based in Houston and serve Miami remotely.

Request a Miami plastic surgery audit

Complimentary and without obligation. Ongoing Miami plastic surgery marketing is not available.
